text:
alex: Quick proposal — add a lightweight status metadata envelope on responses so console + SDK can decide visibility and telemetry buckets.
sam: +1. example fields?
lena: thinking: minimal so we don't explode the payload. maybe: status.code, status.type, status.hint
alex: prototype: `status.code` (machine), `status.hint` (retryable|quota|fallback|user), `status.badge` (degraded|offline|ok), `status.exposure` (public|internal)`
junaid: how does this map to HTTP 4xx/5xx? we shouldn't leak internal semantics to clients.
alex: good call. mapping rule: status.code is our internal enum; SDKs map to HTTP 200 + X-Redwood-Status header for backwards compat; console consumes the enum directly via `status.exposure` to gate display.
marie: for rollout UX we need a flag that says "show to beta users" vs "show to all" — maybe `status.visibility` with values `console-only`, `client-visible`, `silent`
lena: prefer `visibility` over `exposure`? we already used exposure above. keep both: `exposure` = telemetry/internal vs public; `visibility` = UI/SDK display.
sam: telemetry-wise, which label do we use for sampling and alerts? alert on `status.type` == `degraded` or `unavailable` and sample on `hint` == `quota`
junaid: add `status.slug` — a short stable key for dashboards. humans need consistent tags for alerts and runbooks.
alex: agree. final minimal set proposal: `code` (enum), `slug` (string), `hint` (enum), `type` (enum: ok|degraded|unavailable), `visibility` (enum), `badge` (enum). keep names under `status.*` prefix.
marie: SDK compatibility: if `visibility` == `client-visible` expose `X-Redwood-Status` header and JSON `status` field. if `console-only` do not alter HTTP surface.
deploy-bot: deploy started: status-meta-v1 -> staging
lena: question on quotas: when we send hint=quota, should console show quota-meter or redirect to billing? i'd prefer quota hint trigger a lightweight CTA only in console, SDKs just get `quota` hint.
sam: agree. console CTA can be templated using `status.slug`.
junaid: canonical telemetry keys: `status.slug`, `status.type`, `status.hint`, `route` (string), `model_variant` (string). include `route` so we can tie to routing policies.
alex: edge-case: fallback exposures where we route to cheaper model — should we mark both the original request status and fallback status? idea: `status` refers to final outcome; add `orig_intent` metadata `intent_model` if different.
lena: maybe `status.meta` freeform string? but that breaks schema. instead allow `status.details` short string up to 256 chars.
marie: rollout gating: add `status.rollout` field with `gate_id` for experimental flags so console can link to rollout entity.
sam: next steps: write RFC PR with json schema, SDK mapping, and console UI mocks. I can start the PR today.
alex: thanks. sam, can you include examples for how errors look in streaming responses vs normal JSON? keep header fallback consistent.
sam: will do. i'll draft RFC and ping infra for telemetry key registration.
marie: +1. Prefer to keep `status.*` flat under root `status` node so queries in our logs are trivial.
alex: cool. if nobody objects we'll merge the RFC by EOD Fri and push a staging cut.
junaid: no objections here. one last ask: add a short deprecation plan for older `error_code` fields.
alex: noted.
marie: also remind SRE to add new alerting rule templates for `status.type == degraded`.
sam: on it.
alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
